description: This file contains functions for performing system upgrades on a Linux-based embedded device, including image validation, copying configuration, and updating partitions and bootloader components.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the partition layout of the image matches the existing disk layout before upgrading.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the backup configuration to the target partition's mounted filesystem.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the full upgrade process including partition comparison, image writing, and bootloader updating.
